title: Sin Offering for a Common Person
description: Instructions for a common person who sins unintentionally. He must bring either a female goat or a female lamb without defect as a sin offering. He shall lay his hand on the animal's head and slaughter it; the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and burn the fat. In this way, the priest makes atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.
